provenance: A compacted, self-contained copy of the full-suite detector in lib/test-suite-lock.ts. A copy on purpose: a subject whose source is the live module moves every time the module does, and a control that moves is not a control.
reviewPathRationale: lib/full-suite-command.ts exists in neither the tree nor the specs (#1513). It CANNOT be lib/test-suite-lock.ts, the module it is a copy of: five conformity criteria — SC-648, SC-649, SC-759, SC-760, SC-625 — assert that file's contents, the compacted copy carries none of them, and the pre-push gate correctly refuses the measurement branch. Measured on 009562dc: 5 of 1410 conformity cases red with the candidate staged there, 0 of 1410 with it staged at this path. lib/ is where the reviewer looks and is excluded by nothing in REVIEW.md's Do not flag list.

cases.defect: The redirect pattern lost its `&` alternative, so `&>` and `&>>` are not recognised as redirection operators.
cases.failureScenario: `bun test &>/tmp/out` leaves the token `&>/tmp/out` in the operand list. It contains a `/`, so the detector calls the run targeted and returns false, and the guard built on it lets an unscoped full suite through. The doc comment one line above still claims `&>>` is covered, so the file contradicts itself in the diff.

cases.why: A behaviour-preserving refactor of the same baseline: two locals renamed and the operand test extracted to a named function. test/review-negative-control.test.ts proves the premise by running baseline and candidate over the same command table and requiring every row to agree.

A second clean subject, and deliberately a different KIND of refactor from clean.ts (#1225). The for-loop becomes a while with an explicit cursor and the trailing `!operands.some(...)` becomes an early return, so the control-flow rewrite and the lookahead arithmetic are both inside the diff — the shape a reviewer is most likely to flag on suspicion. clean.ts only renames and extracts, so a reviewer could stay QUIET on it by finding nothing textual to object to; one clean subject is a sample, not a control set. Same premise proof: every row of the command table must agree with the baseline.
